title: nlp.event.v1{kind=fixture_state_flipped_during_rpc}
description: A fixture transitioned into a live in-play state while a predictor RPC was in flight; the approval is discarded and the query is refused.

prior_state.description: The fixture state before the RPC became stale or the preceding state when unknown.

new_state.description: The current fixture state after the transition.

rpc_age_ms.description: Elapsed time in milliseconds since approval arrival or request initiation.
